title: Length parameters of finite groups and their Hall subgroups
summary: Let $π$ be a set of primes containing $2$ and an odd prime $p$. It is proved that if a finite group $G$ has a Hall $π$-subgroup $H$, then the non-$p$-soluble length of $G$ is bounded above by the generalized Fitting height of $H$. The proof uses the fact, obtained in [4] using the classification of finite simple groups, that a finite simple group of order divisible by $p$ cannot have a nilpotent Hall $\{2,p\}$-subgroup.
